'''L5-V2''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that served [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Bey'wan Aygo]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] aboard [[Carrick Station]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
L5-V2 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]'', a Digital Expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as the Republic Flashpoint courier for the Kuat Drive Yards Flashpoint, though the droid is only found aboard Carrick Station and not on other planets like other couriers.<ref name="TOR" />
